item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.104
item.description:
Version 1.0.104 changes session startup and fallback behavior for Auto/Autopilot modes, updates how background-task waiting is handled, and makes Assisted Permissions available without experimental mode.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot assisted permissions generally available
item.description:
GitHub Copilot assisted permissions are now generally available in Copilot CLI, the Copilot app, and Visual Studio Code. The feature lets Copilot request permission before running commands or accessing file system paths.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.101
item.description:
Release v1.0.101 adds several CLI and MCP workflow fixes, including native structured output for dynamic workflow subagents on supported models, new assisted approval instructions, and more reliable sign-in and permission handling. It also fixes model selection, session resume/startup behavior, Windows/macOS shell command issues, and multiple provider-specific request and image-limit problems.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.100
item.description:
Release v1.0.100 adds new CLI flags and session/share commands, expands plugin and sandbox handling, and improves account, permission, and model management flows. It also fixes a wide range of reliability issues across MCP, Gemini, Windows, proxy, telemetry, and session browsing.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: github: GitHub App improvements for least privilege and management
item.description:
GitHub released several GitHub App changes aimed at reducing reliance on classic PATs, improving app management, and helping apps request fewer sensitive permissions. The post indicates additional usability improvements for managing GitHub Apps, but the excerpt does not include the full list of changes.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.97
item.description:
Release v1.0.97 adds agent-scoped declarative hooks, improves plugin/MCP handling, and fixes multiple session, permissions, and UI issues. It also changes inline images to render by default on supported terminals and includes several data/output correctness fixes.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Enabling the Bulk admin role for SQL Server on Linux
item.description:
SQL Server on Linux now supports the bulkadmin fixed server role and the ADMINISTER BULK OPERATIONS permission starting with SQL Server 2025 CU9 and SQL Server 2022 CU27. This enables bulk data import operations without requiring users to be members of the sysadmin role.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Control GitHub Actions cache access with cache-mode
item.description:
GitHub Actions now supports cache-mode to control cache access at the workflow or job level. This lets you grant least-privilege cache access instead of broad cache permissions.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Enterprise managed permissions for GitHub Copilot agent operations
item.description:
GitHub Copilot Business and Enterprise admins can now centrally manage agent operation permissions. Admins can set operations to be blocked, require human approval, or run without prompting.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Apps can now access enterprise billing data
item.description:
GitHub Apps can now be granted access to enterprise billing data by enterprise owners. The app configuration flow now includes an enterprise billing permission that can be selected when creating or updating an app.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Enterprise managed settings in GitHub Copilot for JetBrains
item.description:
GitHub Copilot for JetBrains now supports enterprise managed settings. Administrators can centrally control plugin governance, MCP server access, OpenTelemetry, and permission modes across the enterprise.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Triage role can bypass issue creation restrictions
item.description:
GitHub changed issue creation restrictions so users with the triage role can now create issues in repositories where issue creation is limited to collaborators only. Previously, only users with write access could create issues under that setting.

  • Source: GitHub
